title: Humayun Enters Bengal and Occupies Gaur
detail: In 1538, Humayun's campaign reached Bengal and occupied Gaur, signaling the first major Mughal intervention into Bengal's power structure. Although temporary, the move tied Bengal directly to the Mughal-Afghan contest in the east.

title: Historical consequence
detail: The 1538 campaign established Bengal as a central theater in Mughal eastern policy, setting up later rounds of conquest, reversal, and re-entry.
